title: Pi drain injects header-only result envelopes with pi-peer discipline
action: Per plan Approach 3 (rev 2). Add the result-inbox drain to .pi/extensions/bee-guard.ts: registered ONLY from session_start (never load-time), poll timer .unref()d, advisory-class (never throws). Per tick: list this session inbox under .bee/result-inbox/<token>/ (token = own session id); for each marker whose job mailbox holds result-N.json: atomic rename marker -> .processing, inject a FENCED HEADER ONLY (fixed shape: job id, cell id, summary, proof, report_path — the report body NEVER rides the injection) via pi.sendUserMessage — deliverAs steer when busy, plain turn when idle with the F1 latch on before_agent_start; claims consumed at agent_settled (F2), requeued on failed injection, orphans reclaimed at session_start. At-least-once; job id is the dedupe key and the header says so. Keep every existing belt behavior untouched.

truths: no timer exists before session_start and node exits cleanly after the harness run
the injected fence contains header fields only
failed injection requeues its own claim; orphans reclaim at session_start

artifacts.substantive: drain with claim/requeue/reclaim discipline, header-only injection

key_links: drain reuses the belt binary-resolution chain and advisory wrapper
prohibitions: No report body in the injection
No throw from any drain path
No changes to blocking guard behavior
